text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black opted out of the Satsuki Sho 
and watched from the stands, witnessing 
Brusquemaen's overwhelming performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she spots Air Groove 
surrounded by reporters asking about 
Brusqueman. Kitasan Black loses her 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Classic Triple Crown has only 
just begun. Rallied by Sakura Bakushin O's 
boundless energy, Kitasan Black dashed off 
once more.
